language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The wooden spoon is initially on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around its handle and lifts it clear of the table (frames 63–83, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then carries it to the open drawer (frames 100–158, image and wrist_image). At frames 159–163, wrist_image shows the spoon released into the drawer and the gripper opening above it; image shows the spoon remaining inside the drawer as the robot withdraws through frame 175. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or unrelated object displacement is visible.
